focus_line: Equity Research · Financial Modeling · Market Analysis
hero_desc: I research markets and companies for an investment firm. Most of my work is turning raw financial data into clear analysis: building models, tracking market trends, and writing reports that support investment decisions.
intro_tagline: The part I enjoy most is where research meets code — pulling data together, building models, and turning numbers into a clear view of what is actually going on.
subTitle: Research analyst with a software engineering background.
bio_desc: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at SRM University AP, currently a Research Analyst at Black Komodo Investments (BKI), working remotely. I research markets and companies, build financial models, and turn raw data into analysis that supports investment decisions.

Before that I worked as a software engineer, including a full-stack internship at BKI building features with React.js and Spring Boot. That background shapes how I do research: I automate data gathering where I can and lean on reproducible analysis over one-off spreadsheets.

On the side: a RAG-based Git analyzer that answers questions about a repo's commit history, an AI resume builder, and a roommate-finding app. Oracle Certified Professional for Java SE 17, and an open-source contributor. Away from the screen I volunteer with NSS — blood donation camps and beach clean-ups, mostly.
